seattle-new-york.scene: A transcontinental journey from the evergreen Puget Sound and Seattle's timber waterfront to the copper Statue of Liberty and elegant New York skyline, winding train tracks through distant prairie.

los-angeles-new-york.scene: A golden California mission and tall palms on the left, distant desert railway crossing broad plains, the Statue of Liberty and handsome Manhattan waterfront on the right.

los-angeles-miami.scene: A sunlit journey from a California Spanish mission and fan palms, through a terracotta desert railway, to Miami's turquoise Atlantic bay and lush royal palms.

vancouver-montreal.scene: Vancouver's mountain-framed harbor with a little sailboat and cedar trees blending into Montreal's twin-tower stone basilica and St Lawrence waterfront in a sunny Canadian panorama.

san-francisco-atlanta.scene: San Francisco's colorful hillside Victorian homes and a historic bay ferry blending into Atlanta's grand red-brick railway terminal beneath magnolias, peach sunlight.

portland-nashville.scene: Portland's evergreen river valley with a handsome iron truss railway bridge blending into Nashville's elegant classical capitol and a paddle steamer, warm afternoon sunlight.

los-angeles-chicago.scene: Los Angeles mission arches and tall palms blending into Chicago's grand early railway station and graceful lakeshore buildings beside sapphire Lake Michigan.

montreal-new-orleans.scene: Montreal's grey stone waterfront and twin Gothic basilica towers blending into New Orleans's pastel French Quarter balconies and a white Mississippi paddlewheel steamer.

calgary-phoenix.scene: Calgary's open golden foothills beneath the snowy Canadian Rockies, a tiny distant red railway train, blending into Phoenix's warm Sonoran desert with tall saguaro cacti.

vancouver-santa-fe.scene: A luminous Vancouver inlet and blue snowy coastal mountains with cedar trees blending into Santa Fe's sculptural adobe pueblo architecture, copper mesas and desert juniper.

boston-miami.scene: Boston's red brick waterfront and a historic tall sailing ship blending into Miami's aquamarine tropical shore and elegant cream buildings behind wind-swept palms.

winnipeg-houston.scene: Winnipeg's handsome stone railway station in open golden prairie country blending into Houston's verdant bayou beneath a brilliant sky, early railway warehouses and graceful oak trees.

portland-phoenix.scene: Pacific Northwest cedar trees and a Portland river bridge blending into Phoenix's dramatic red desert mesas and monumental saguaro cacti, tiny railway winding through landscape.

dallas-new-york.scene: Dallas's red sandstone courthouse and golden Texas wildflowers blending into New York's harbor, copper Statue of Liberty and a graceful early skyline, sunlit railway journey.

denver-pittsburgh.scene: Denver's gold-domed capitol below blue Rocky Mountains blending into Pittsburgh's three rivers and majestic iron railway bridges, early brick riverside mills with clean optimistic morning light.

winnipeg-little-rock.scene: Winnipeg's open golden prairie and stone station blending into Little Rock's lush green river valley and the elegant Arkansas capitol dome, winding railway beneath cotton clouds.

toronto-miami.scene: Toronto's grand red-brick Romanesque old city hall and blue Lake Ontario blending into Miami's turquoise coast with sunny villas, palms and a small white sailing boat.

duluth-el-paso.scene: Duluth's massive iron aerial lift bridge above deep blue Lake Superior blending into El Paso's golden desert foothills and Spanish mission with yucca plants.

sault-ste-marie-oklahoma-city.scene: A handsome freighter passing green wooded Sault Ste. Marie canal locks blending into Oklahoma City's golden plains and elegant frontier brick railway station, endless optimistic sky.

seattle-los-angeles.scene: A coastal train journey from Seattle's tall cedars and island-studded Puget Sound, along the Pacific cliff coast, into Los Angeles's warm white Spanish mission arches and palms.

chicago-santa-fe.scene: Chicago's monumental early stone railway terminal and Lake Michigan blue blending into Santa Fe's amber adobe church, pinon pine and rose desert mesas.

montreal-atlanta.scene: Montreal's twin Gothic basilica towers and French stone waterfront blending into Atlanta's ornate red-brick station and blooming magnolia, soft amber afternoon.

duluth-houston.scene: Duluth's iron lift bridge and blue Lake Superior harbor blending into Houston's lush slow bayou, great live oaks, and handsome early railway district.

helena-los-angeles.scene: Helena's copper-domed capitol among Montana's forested foothills blending into Los Angeles's sunlit Spanish mission and slender palm trees, distant railway.

sault-ste-marie-nashville.scene: The clear green Great Lakes shipping canal at Sault Ste. Marie with a white lake steamer blending into Nashville's classical stone capitol and rolling emerald hills.

calgary-salt-lake-city.scene: Calgary's foothill grasslands beneath snowy rugged Canadian Rocky Mountains blending into Salt Lake City's elegant domed capitol, silver-blue lake and rugged Wasatch peaks.

chicago-new-orleans.scene: Chicago's grand lakeside early railway buildings and blue water blending into New Orleans's lively but unpeopled pastel French Quarter balconies, Mississippi paddlewheel steamer and southern magnolias.

new-york-atlanta.scene: New York's copper Statue of Liberty and early harbor skyline blending into Atlanta's elegant brick railway terminal and green magnolia trees, winding railway through soft hills.

kansas-city-houston.scene: Kansas City's monumental Beaux-Arts Union Station and fountain blending into Houston's leafy bayou and charming brick railway buildings beneath oak trees, golden prairie between.

denver-el-paso.scene: Denver's elegant gold-domed capitol and blue snowcapped Colorado mountains blending into El Paso's sun-warmed desert mission, yucca and layered Franklin Mountain foothills.
